_why_one_claim: R only, so there is no agreement claim; check.py records it as untested. RECOVERY asks whether the estimate is close to the parameter the fixture used; harness/clustered_examples.test.py adds adaptive quadrature as an oracle.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: 0.03 a patient-day x a ward multiplier exp(N(0, 0.25)) x 0.6 in the intervention arm

agreement._note: In place of a second language, harness/clustered_examples.test.py refits with 10-point adaptive quadrature (agreeing with Laplace to 2e-5 here), and shows a Poisson GLM ignoring the wards has a smaller standard error (0.096 against 0.127).

recovery.claim: the log rate ratio is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: At 30 wards with a rate ratio of 0.7 the miss equalled the effect; the fixture uses 40 wards and a rate ratio of 0.6. Measured in R by harness/clustered_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99.
